description:
Space-Based Pushpak Viman – Concept, Technology and Future Possibilities

The Space-Based Pushpak Viman can be imagined as a futuristic aerospace transportation system inspired by the ancient Indian concept of Pushpaka Vimana from the Ramayana.

It combines ideas from:

Spacecraft and reusable launch vehicles.

Artificial intelligence (AI)-based navigation.

Wireless power transmission.

Electric and ion propulsion.

Autonomous space transportation.

Interplanetary travel.
